text:
lee: quick postmortem note from the staged rollout last night. small cohort saw p95 drift during host evictions. appears related to cold prefix reads when affinity holds.
lee: impact: ~4% of requests experienced 1.8x p95 for ~10m window while draining proceeded.
nana: timeline? was there a concurrent autoscale?
lee: yes autoscale + graceful drain. affinity kept routing session traffic to draining nodes before their local prefix had chance to be prefetched.
devon: idea: instead of blind split-by-weight probes, try "prefetch-led" handoff. send lightweight prefetch tokens on a tiny fraction of requests to trigger KV warm on the target ahead of routing increase.
mira: interesting. how is that different from probe_pct?
devon: probe_pct routes whole requests to target. prefetch-led keeps request on old host but emits a non-blocking prefetch call to the target for the prefixes the session is likely to use. cheaper and lower risk.
lee: would need signals for what to prefetch. session history can give top-k prefixes; also sample next-token heuristics.
nana: decision surface? what do we use to decide to promote traffic to target? keep compact: p95_ratio, prefetch_hit_rate_on_target, and target_queue_util.
devon: propose config proto (strings in config):
```json
{"strategy":"prefetch-led","start_prefetch_rate":"1%","max_prefetch_rate":"8%","prefetch_window_s":"60","p95_ratio_thresh":"1.6","prefetch_hit_rate_thresh":"0.7"}
```
mira: operationally: start_prefetch_rate low, then increase prefetch if target reports warm hits. once prefetch_hit_rate > threshold && p95_ratio is OK, increment routing weight.
lee: also add a backoff on failures: if p95_ratio jumps or prefetch_hit_rate falls, drop routing weight and increase prefetch to help.
nana: eviction semantics: do we maintain session affinity until end? my vote: keep affinity-bind for existing sessions but prefetch target for new messages in the session (hybrid). migration later as opt-in.
devon: telemetry: Console needs per-cohort panels: prefetch_rate, prefetch_success, p95_ratio, last-fallback, and a sampled trace link. ops-bot: will emit prefetch events to rollout stream when prefetch_hit_rate < 0.5 for >2m.
mira: testing: unit tests for prefetch state machine, canary with synthetic long-chat traces, chaos test injecting KV cold starts on target.
lee: runbook: on prefetch-failure alert run quickchecks: recent drain list, prefetch latency, target queue depth. steps: 1) pause cutover, 2) increase prefetch_rate, 3) if sustained p95 delta > threshold rollback. ping eng-oncall for 24h post rollout.
devon: simulator note: prefetch tradeoff depends on cache eviction ROI. I'll build a small sim to model prefix reuse vs prefetch cost and tune prefetch_rate caps.
nana: also add tenant-level knobs; big customers with long sessions should have higher prefetch priority.
lee: finalize: I'll draft an RFC with the config examples, observability checklist, and runbook. Mira can help wire the Console panels. ops-bot: scheduled-canary: job 2024-05-03T01:00Z scheduled for variant v7; will notify eng-platform on prefetch/fallback events.
mira: will add dashboards and an alert: prefetch_success < 0.6 over 5m for any cohort.
devon: thanks folks. i'll include sim results in the RFC. leans toward prefetched-first approach to avoid traffic jitter. :thumbsup:
